title: critmin-network-models: the SEAR Lab's critical-mineral network models (critmin-net)
description: critmin-net, the SEAR Lab's critical-minerals supply-chain network model: the lithium-ion battery supply chain to 2040 (mining, refining, precursor, anode and cathode material, cells, end uses and recycling) in five regions with trade between them, every market a calibrated supply, demand or cost curve, with US tariffs, 45X, China's export controls and the DRC's cobalt quota. Calibrated to 2023-2024 and checked against 2025. Results are preliminary. Code MIT; data (models/critmin-net/src/critmin_net/data/) CC BY 4.0, every number with its source.
